title: 第 20 章外门弟子竟然如此猖狂
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
“那个混蛋！”

    苏婉清回到住处之后整个人都气得不行，她一进门就坐在椅子上脸色铁青手心还有点微疼。

    刚才在藏经阁二楼的时候陈默那一掌拍在她的肩膀上，虽然没有受什么重伤但那股力道震得她半边身子都酸麻了好一阵。

    而侍女看到苏婉清的脸色之后心中也是一惊，于是连忙倒了一杯茶端过去小心翼翼的放在桌上。

    “小姐您怎么了是谁惹您生气了。”侍女问道。

    “还能有谁还不是那个陈默。”

    当侍女听到这个名字之后愣了一下，那个陈默不就是上次闯进小姐房间又躲在浴池里偷看的那个外门弟子吗？

    “他怎么又惹到小姐了。”侍女问道。

    “他擅闯藏经阁二楼。”

    “藏经阁二楼，那不是只有内门弟子才能去的地方吗他一个外门弟子怎么敢上去的。”

    “谁知道他怎么上去的，守阁的江前辈说是他让陈默上去的，我真是搞不懂江前辈为什么要护着那个混蛋。”

    当侍女听完之后眉头皱了起来，这个陈默也太嚣张了一个外门弟子又是闯闺房又是偷看洗澡现在连藏经阁二楼都敢闯？

    “而且他还跟我动了手。”苏婉清说道。

    “什么，他一个外门弟子敢跟小姐动手他不要命了？”

    “他身上有一件上品法器叫乾坤镜，那镜子能放出很强的光芒，我一时没防备中了招被他拍了一掌。”

    听到这话之后侍女整个人都傻了，要知道上品法器乾坤镜那可不是什么凡物啊，而且他一个外门弟子怎么会有上品法器。

    “小姐放心，迟早我要把他的底细查个一清二楚。”

    那侍女站在一旁不断的说着，语气里充满了对陈默的不满。

    “这个外门弟子实在太嚣张了他以为自己是谁啊，竟然连小姐都敢得罪。”

    “之后必须给他点教训看看，不然他还以为小姐好欺负呢。”

    “不用你说我自己会处理，等我查清楚他的底细看我怎么收拾他。”

    而侍女正想再说几句的时候门外忽然响起了敲门声。

    这时苏婉清的眉头皱了起来，她在心里想着这个时候谁会来找她。

    “何人。”

    “婉清师妹是我，周牧之。”门外传来一个男子的声音。

    当苏婉清听到这个名字之后脸色一下子沉了下来，怎么又是这个人。

    门外这个叫周牧之的内门执剑长老门下的大弟子，修为在元婴期一层，天赋出众相貌也算英俊。
content_en:
"That bastard!"

    Su Wanqing was extremely angry when she returned to her residence. As soon as she entered the door, she sat on a chair with a livid face and a slight pain in her palms.

    Just now when she was on the second floor of the Sutra Pavilion, Chen Mo slapped her on the shoulder. Although she wasn't seriously injured, the force made half of her body feel sore and numb for a while.

    The maid was also shocked when she saw Su Wanqing's face, so she quickly poured a cup of tea and put it carefully on the table.

    "Miss, what's wrong? Who made you angry?" the maid asked.

    "Who else is not that Chen Mo?"

    When the maid heard this name, she was stunned. Isn't that Chen Mo the same outer disciple who broke into the lady's room last time and hid in the bath to peek?

    "Why did he mess with the lady again?" the maid asked.

    "He broke into the second floor of the Sutra Pavilion without permission."

    "On the second floor of the Sutra Pavilion, isn't that a place only inner disciples can go to? How dare he, an outer disciple, go up there?"

    "Who knows how he got up? Senior Jiang who was guarding the pavilion said he asked Chen Mo to go up. I really don't understand why Senior Jiang is protecting that bastard."

    The maid frowned after hearing this. This Chen Mo is too arrogant. An outer disciple broke into the boudoir and peeked into the shower. Now he even dares to break into the second floor of the Sutra Pavilion?

    "And he even made a move on me." Su Wanqing said.

    "What, he, an outer disciple, dares to fight against the young lady and he will die?"

    "He has a high-grade magic weapon called the Qiankun Mirror. The mirror can emit a very strong light. I was caught unprepared and was slapped by him."

    After hearing this, the maid was completely stunned. You must know that the high-grade magical artifact, the Qiankun Mirror, is not an ordinary object, and how could an outer disciple of him have a high-grade magical artifact.

    "Don't worry, miss. Sooner or later I will find out all his details."

    The maid stood aside and kept talking, her tone full of dissatisfaction with Chen Mo.

    "This outer disciple is so arrogant. Who does he think he is? He even dares to offend the young lady."

    "You must teach him a lesson later, otherwise he will think that the young lady is easy to bully."

    "You don't need to tell me that I will handle it myself. Wait until I find out his details and see how I deal with him."

    The maid was about to say a few more words when there was a sudden knock on the door.

    Su Wanqing's brows furrowed at this time, and she was thinking in her mind who would come to her at this time.

    "Who?"

    "Junior Sister Wanqing, this is me, Zhou Muzhi." A man's voice came from outside the door.

    When Su Wanqing heard this name, her face suddenly darkened. Why was it this person again.

    The eldest disciple of the sword-wielding elder from the inner sect named Zhou Muzhi outside the sect was at the first level of Nascent Soul stage. He had outstanding talent and handsome appearance.
title_en: Chapter 20 The outer disciples are so rampant
